title: sorbus sambucifolia
intro: Sorbus sambucifolia, commonly known as the Chinese Rowan, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China and parts of Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, potentially aiding in the treatment of fever, sore throats, and other infections. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus sambucifolia include expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in relieving coughs and respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
